full.description: This image is a photomicrograph of lung tissue. It shows extensive involvement of the pulmonary parenchyma with abnormal vascular proliferation. The histology demonstrates spindle-shaped cells and slit-like vascular spaces. These findings are characteristic of Kaposi's sarcoma in the lung.

random.description: This image is a photomicrograph of lung tissue showing significant architectural distortion. The section displays regions of compressed lung parenchyma adjacent to a dense, solid lesion or scar on the lower left. The alveolar spaces appear stretched or enlarged, consistent with severe emphysematous changes or destruction from an adjacent mass. The histological features suggest a pathological process involving lung tissue, potentially related to tumor infiltration or chronic fibrotic disease.
